verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a documented Device Authorization plugin implementing RFC 8628 (OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant) explicitly for CLI applications, IoT devices, and other limited-input devices, and even provides a CLI-based way to test the flow. Missing for 10: no independent/community hands-on report of using the device flow specifically (only vendor docs), and no explicit example of agent/headless AI use beyond CLI framing.
